"Fairway" is a visual journey through the soul of the golf course — a collage that reveals the landscape in layers, much like the game itself. This artwork peels back the course piece by piece, from tee to green, showcasing rolling hills, bunkers, fairways, and roughs in a stacked, almost geological composition. Each layer is a memory, a challenge, a step toward the hole.

Ciel Glue's retro-inspired golf art complements any home, cafe, shop, golf club or space that values vintage art and design, golf culture, or contemporary home decor. products.title: Left of Field x Hiroki Sunday Carry Bag - Sage Green
products.body_html:
The LEFT OF FIELD x HIROKI SUNDAY CARRY BAG combines Hiroki’s high-quality craftsmanship with Left of Field's creative design.

This unique bag design pays homage to the bush landscapes of the East Coast of Australia, drawing on the natural influences from the upbringing of Left of Field’s Founder, Nick Ilias.

Crafted from waxed canvas with suede accents, the bag features side and front waterproof pockets. The distinctive front pocket is printed with a design inspired by the Sydney Red Gum Tree (Angophora Costata / Kajimbourra), a significant symbol of the urban bush in which Sydney resides.

The yellow leather accent trims draw inspiration from the vibrant blooms that grace the region in the early months of the year while also complement the green and gold hues, synonymous with Australia’s national colors.
